meta.clause_rule: V0 (section 4.2): cut after every maximal run of G
meta.content: Part-of-speech code sequences only; no corpus text. 'codes' = one code per word token; 'clauses' = the same codes cut into verb-bounded units by rule V0. Unknown words are stored as C (see unknown_positions.json).
meta.order: Sentence order is the order of the extraction file, which is sorted by schema string (K1) or by schema frequency and then schema string (K2); it is NOT the running-text order. Every exponent in the paper is a mean over 20 random shuffles, so this order does not enter any reported value.
